messages:
mira: heads-up — master e2e is red, started ~10m ago. failing consistently on gardener deploy. job: https://ci.internal/reports/12458 :eyes:
ci-bot: Build #12458 (master) — FAILED in 12m — tests/e2e/gardener/test_deploy_flow.py::TestGardenerDeploy::test_scale_up (x3 flakes)
anya: the stack trace looks like a timeout talking to k8s API server, but the error started right after the bump to ubuntu-22.04 image last night?
jc: pinging the PR list — we merged a couple infra-y PRs: #1297 (kube client bump), #1302 (base image -> ubuntu-22.04). last green on master was commit 5f1a2c3 (2026-03-12 02:11 UTC)
sam: can we bisect to a commit range? if last green is 5f1a2c3 and master is now 9b7c8d0, I can run the bisect script on the runner host.
mira: yeah please do. suggested quick bisect: ./scripts/ci/bisect_e2e.sh --test tests/e2e/gardener/test_deploy_flow.py::TestGardenerDeploy::test_scale_up --good 5f1a2c3 --bad HEAD
ci-bot: note: the bisect script will spawn real k8s clusters and costs credits; set BISECT_DRY_RUN=1 to only run smoke checks first.
jc: @sam if you find a first-bad commit include the short sha and the PR number. if it's infra (image or kube client) we should coordinate a revert with @ops-bot to avoid mass reruns.
sam: starting bisect now (running on runner-12). will update with first-bad or logs.
ops-bot: FYI — if revert requested, please include revert rationale and ETA for patch rollout in the revert PR template.
(20m later) sam: bisect finished: first-bad = 8c3d4f2 (PR #1302) — base image bump. reproduces locally when running the same ubuntu-22.04 image on our infra runner.
anya: nice catch. does the test timeout due to different kubeclient cert defaults? stack snippet:
```
E   kubernetes.client.exceptions.ApiException: (504)
E   Reason: Gateway Timeout
E   HTTP response headers: ...
E   body: {"message":"timed out waiting for pods"}
```
mira: thanks @sam. plan:1) open a revert PR for #1302 (temporary), 2) pin affected runners back to previous image, 3) follow up with image diff and root cause. I'll open the revert and request an urgent review. anyone object? :thumbsup:
jc: no objections, :+1: from me. I'll help review revert and ensure job queue throttling while we revert to avoid hammering infra.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window not required for a revert of build image on runner pool, but coordinate if you need live node reboots.
mira: created revert PR 1310 -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/1310 — tagging @jc @anya @ops-bot for review. will monitor CI after merge.
ci-bot: Re-run queued for master after PR 1310 merged. will post results.
(15m later) ci-bot: Build #12463 (after revert) — PASSED. gardener e2e green. :tada:
mira: closing the loop — reverting #1302 fixed the flake. follow-up issue filed to audit image changes and run e2e matrix on a canary pool before wide rollout: https://issues.internal/RED-872
jc: follow-up: add kubeclient integration tests to pre-merge for infra PRs that touch base images or client libs.
anya: agreed. thanks all for quick triage.
